Asset type: bird identification atlas transparent PNG variant.
Input image: sole EDIT TARGET, the normal adult source of this species.
Primary request: Adult male European honey buzzard, pale morph: make the underbody and underwing coverts very pale cream/white with sparse brown markings. Preserve the source's dark carpal patches and barred flight feathers and tail. Keep the adult yellow iris. Retain all original feather detail, only recolor/repattern plumage.
Canvas: preserve the original 1254 by 1254 pixels.
Constraints: This is an EDIT of the provided normal adult bird image, not a new bird illustration. Preserve its exact pose, leftward flight direction, perspective, outline/silhouette, every wing and tail feather position, head/beak/feet geometry, framing, canvas dimensions, subject size and position and realistic illustration style. Change ONLY the requested plumage/eye/cere colors and markings. Keep the whole bird fully uncropped. Preserve the actual transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no solid background, no shadow, no text. The existing source silhouette and composition must not move when toggling variants.

Input image: sole EDIT TARGET, original NORMAL ADULT MALE Bateleur. Convert only plumage to adult FEMALE cream-backed morph directly on this exact source image.
